url.description: External homepage for the ring, if it has one

rules.description: Plain text rules a member publication is expected to follow. Not markdown or HTML; renderers display it as text.

button.description: Small image identifying the ring, shown beside its name in member sites' ring navigation

members.description: Publications the owner lists in the ring. Array order is the circle's order. A listed publication is a member only when its owner's repo also holds a blog.rebase.webring.membership record naming this ring and that publication.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the ring was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the ring was last edited

description.description: Plain text theme of the ring. Not markdown or HTML; renderers display it as text.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the owner added this publication to the ring

publication.description: AT URI of the member's site.standard.publication record. Name, URL, and icon are resolved from that record, never copied here.

schema.description: A webring: a named, themed, ordered circle of publications, curated by the account whose repo holds this record
